items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for public launch and monetization expansion; conditional for ordinary bounded reversible growth; counsel_required for upstream rights, public data display, affiliate or advertising use, trademark/image/price claims, and alert use. Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private and keep permission outreach unsent. Evidence: Woot API documentation confirms access mechanics only; current terms restrict proposed commercial/public data use. Compliance is technical-only at 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Analytics quality is yellow, operations and fleet-doctor evidence are unavailable, and revenue is partial aggregate with $4.92 unattributed. Do not treat missing telemetry as zero or clearance.

Launch-readiness tracking: active; 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. Existing evidence includes official Woot API, terms, support records, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms. No task closes because rights, field provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, security, attribution, measurement, and owner evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use decisions: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked; missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident procedures, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, and incident inventory.

Legal review of the proposed factory work: complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net remain parked/private and are not cleared for implementation or publication. The concrete blocker is missing execution-owner verification plus missing preview/build, compliance, security, analytics/affiliate, measurement, and rollback evidence. Continue only the existing readiness artifact; next evidence action is to attach dated owner verification, preview/build results, compliance checklist results, and explicit unknowns for analytics and monetization. No launch or implementation decision is approved.

Legal disposition: continue existing affiliate reviews only. Preserve affiliate disclosures, provenance, registered tracking IDs, destination integrity, claims substantiation, and platform-policy boundaries. Do not expand monetization or claim revenue, ROI, or causal lift. The $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 remains unattributed.
Continue the existing launch-readiness evidence bundle and keep the private gate unchanged. Keep permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.
